name: Starbucks
summary: Coffee retail flagship. Four-tier earth-green system, warm cream canvas, proprietary SoDoSans typography

colors.name: Starbucks Green
colors.role: The historic brand green. Used on h1 headings, primary section headers on the Rewards page, and as the main brand signal wherever a single dominant color is needed.

colors.name: Green Accent
colors.role: A slightly brighter, more luminous green. The primary filled-CTA color ("Explore our afternoon menu", "See the spring menu") and the fill of the floating Frap circular button.

colors.name: House Green
colors.role: The deep near-black brand green. Footer surface, feature-band backgrounds, reward-status dark surfaces, and the headline "Free coffee is just the beginning" hero band on Rewards.

colors.name: Green Uplift
colors.role: A secondary mid-dark green used sparingly on decorative accents and dark-gradient moments.

colors.name: Green Light
colors.role: A pale mint wash used for form-valid-state tints and light green utility surfaces.

colors.name: Gold
colors.role: Reserved almost exclusively for Rewards-status ceremony — Gold-tier callouts, partnership badges (SkyMiles, Bonvoy), and premium-feeling accents. Never a general-purpose brand color.

colors.name: Gold Light
colors.role: Softer gold for background washes on gold-tier sections.

colors.name: Gold Lightest
colors.role: Cream-gold page-surface wash used under partnership sections on the Rewards page — ties the gold accent back into the warm neutral system.

colors.name: White
colors.role: Primary card and modal surface. Also card fill on gift-card tiles.

colors.name: Neutral Cool
colors.role: Subtle cool-gray surface used on dropdown menus ("Account" dropdown), form-card wraps, and quiet utility containers.

colors.name: Neutral Warm
colors.role: The warm cream **primary page canvas** for Rewards utility zones and hero bands.

colors.name: Ceramic
colors.role: A slightly warmer/darker cream for zone separators, soft page-section washes, and Rewards partnership band.

colors.name: Black
colors.role: Deep ink reserved for the dark top-of-page CTA strip ("Join now") and high-contrast top-nav sign-in buttons.

colors.name: Rewards Green
colors.role: A dedicated muted slate-green used only on Rewards-page text blocks — a slightly "dustier" reading color than Text Black that signals "reward surface" without using full Starbucks Green.

colors.name: Red
colors.role: Error and destructive state (form invalid, destructive actions).

substitutesNote:
SoDoSans is proprietary to Starbucks (licensed from House Industries, not publicly available). Reasonable open-source substitutes:
- **Inter** (Google Fonts) — similar humanist geometric proportions, wide weight range
- **Manrope** — slightly rounder, similar confident feel
- **Nunito Sans** — warmer, good for a "café" brand substitute

If substituting, verify the tight `-0.01em` / `-0.16px` tracking still reads well; some open-source fonts need `-0.005em` instead.

Lander Tall (the Rewards serif) is custom — open-source substitutes: **Iowan Old Style** (already in fallback), **Lora**, or **Source Serif Pro**. Kalam (Careers script) is available on Google Fonts directly.
